fact: Portaria Conjunta n.º 50/2024 of 27 December 2024 declares the SIJ and its SIPP application in operation, and the electronic criminal process obligatory, in the Polícia Nacional's services within the comarcas of Praia and São Vicente from 30 January 2025, and in the services of the remaining judicial areas on a date to be notified in writing at least thirty days ahead by the head of the SIJ's managing entity to the Director Nacional; it names no number of esquadras.
title: Boletim Oficial, I Série, n.º 124 — Portaria Conjunta n.º 50/2024 de 27 de dezembro
publisher: Boletim Oficial da República de Cabo Verde (Ministério da Justiça e Ministério da Administração Interna)
